requirement: An organizer exclusion (request plus a second person's co-sign, with a recorded reason) is shown everywhere as 'Excluded (organizer decision)'. It is never worded as a governing-body disqualification. Scratch, No-show, Excluded and Disqualified stay distinct; the status 'disqualified' is not a supported DanceFlow disciplinary action.
enforcement_point: Wording in the results review UI and action notices; behavior stays in the CF1 A5 database functions (migration 20270120094000), unchanged.

tests.name: the label is 'Excluded (organizer decision)' and is used for managers and everyone else
no user-facing exclusion surface says disqualified / DQ / disqualification (except the explicit disclaimer)

interpretation_notes: Wording only. The public results page still shows 'Not placed' for scratched, no-show and excluded couples together (the public reader does not expose the kind); see OD20-DISQUALIFIED-STATUS-REACHABILITY for the separate status gap.
